docs_listed: developer site: 85 homes of 2 and 3 bedrooms, 65 to 90 m2 built, 5 floors, plans tab, 360 tour, specification, commercial dossier (Oct 2026), purchase guide
developer site: 'Urban Resort' amenities (pool, gym, wellness with sauna, gourmet room, solar PV, aerothermal)
Alicante Plaza / Javea.com (Mar 2026): urban conformity certificate obtained, licence expected the following month, 26-month build, 20% sold, prices EUR 248,000 to 352,000, 80 to 112 m2
SodaCrowd: licence 'in process', EUR 24.7m total investment, EUR 2m crowdfunded equity, projected investor IRR 17.3%
Observatorio Inmobiliario (Apr 2026): buyer-investor scheme from EUR 230,000 with estimated 15% to 20% return reducing final price
note: 85-home block in Jávea's old town promoted by Valencia-based Talvion, part-funded through the CNMV-licensed crowdfunding platform SodaCrowd; in March 2026 the licence was still in process with works planned from May 2026 and a 26-month build. Plans and specifications are published, but no licence number, deposit guarantee or progress update, and unit sizes and entry prices differ between sources. (checked 1 Nov 2026)
